paper_title: FactBench A Dynamic Benchmark for In-the-Wild Language Model Factuality   Evaluation
caption:
Distribution of LM’s answer refusal categories
on FACTBENCH

annotations.annotation: The collection of four pie charts compares different aspects labeled in terms of problem areas or themes across four models. Each chart has distinct segments labeled with specific categories and associated percentages. The "GPT4-o" chart consists of two slices, with "Lack of Knowledge" in orange occupying 83.3% and "Safety" in a lighter orange at 16.7%. The "Gemini1.5-Pro" chart is composed of four slices: "Misinformation" in orange makes up 38.4%, "Lack of Knowledge" in dark blue represents 22.1%, "Ethical Advice" in light blue accounts for 16.3%, and "Clarification" in yellow is 14.0%, with "Safety" in red at 9.3%. The third chart, "Llama3.1-70B-Instruct," features two slices: "Lack of Knowledge" in orange at 75.0%, and "Clarification" in red at 25.0%. The final chart, "Llama3.1-405B-Instruct," displays two equal slices: "Misinformation" in red and "Lack of Knowledge" in orange, each comprising 50.0%. Labels and percentage values are shown within the slices of each chart, with no slices visually emphasized beyond color differences. No legends are present, as each segment is self-labeled.
